title: HedgeMate
tagline: Health Guardian for Defi-Protocols using Vincent Apps and Self-Healing Loan feature!!!
description: This project's is a Health Guardian App built such that the user can relax even when the market goes down and can repay the loan of the users on AAVE using the Vincent Protocol and the PYTH Oracle .A user can use this app to pay their loans automatically ,the app will check time to time the Price Feed and will protect him from liquidating when the price of some asset goes down .
how_its_made: This project uses the Vincent-Starter-App and the PYTH Oracle for fetching the price feeds .We used the PYTH pull integration to get the price and the app continuously check for the price of asset to make sure whenever the price goes down ,the app automatically repays the loan and save the user from getting liquidated .
